enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Remains still. Breathes steadily. Shifts legs. Pulls blanket up. Lies still. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up in bed. Swings legs over side. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Lifts toilet lid. Urinates. Flushes toilet. Washes hands. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Turns off tap. Wipes face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Cracks eggs into bowl. Adds milk. Whisk eggs. Pours mixture into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off stove. Slides eggs onto plate. Pours boiling water into cup. Sits at table. Eats eggs. Drinks tea. Stands up. Places dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a bag for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Opens closet. Takes out shirt and pants. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens drawer. Takes out laptop. Places laptop in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office (walking/public transit)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Rides bus. Reaches stop. Stands up. Pulls cord. Exits bus. Walks to office building. Enters building. Walks to office. Opens office door. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: planning events, coordinating with partner organizations, answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens email client. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Types on keyboard. Clicks mouse. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Makes phone call. Talks to partner organization. Writes notes. Opens document. Types report. Saves document. Attends meeting. Discusses event planning. Takes notes. Returns to desk. Continues typing.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to lunch place. Enters restaurant. Orders food. Pays cashier. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Wipes mouth with napkin. Throws trash in bin. Stands up. Walks out of restaurant. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing program coordination work: writing reports, scheduling volunteers, preparing workshop materials
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens document. Types report. Reviews report. Saves report. Opens calendar. Schedules volunteers. Sends email invitations. Opens spreadsheet. Updates volunteer list. Prints workshop materials. Collects printouts. Staples packets. Organizes materials. Places materials in folder. Files folder. Checks email. Replies to urgent email. Closes computer.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Reaches stop. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks home. Opens front door. Enters house. Closes door.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and chicken. Closes refrigerator. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds chicken. Cooks chicken. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Turns off stove. Slides food onto plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Places dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on tap. Picks up sponge. Applies soap. Washes plate. Rinses plate. Places plate in rack. Washes fork. Rinses fork. Places fork in rack. Washes glass. Rinses glass. Places glass in rack. Turns off tap. Picks up cloth. Wipes counter. Rinses cloth. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth. Turns off light.

Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Scrolls through phone. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out snack. Returns to living room. Sits on couch. Eats snack. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up.

Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Wets body. Picks up soap. Applies soap to body. Scrubs body. Rinses body. Picks up shampoo. Applies shampoo to hair. Scrubs hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around hair. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review tomorrow's program schedule and wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Opens calendar. Reviews schedule. Makes notes. Closes calendar. Opens email. Reads email. Closes email. Turns off laptop. Closes laptop. Stands up. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Lies down on bed. Closes eyes.

Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Remains still. Breathes steadily. Shifts legs. Pulls blanket up. Lies still. Continues sleeping.
